description_en: Queries the number of assets that are assigned public IP addresses with abnormal status and the number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribeExcpetionCount查询指定地域下，状态异常的公网IP资产的数量和即将过期的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
name: DescribeExcpetionCount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin.

Note: This parameter is actually required. If it is not provided, the service returns the `DDosBgp.CheckError.InvalidRegion` (HTTP 400) error
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。

注意：此参数实际为必填项。未提供时，服务将返回 `DDosBgp.CheckError.InvalidRegion`（HTTP 400）错误
parameters.name: region_id

ExceptionIpCount.description_en: The number of abnormal IP addresses (for example, those in the Black Hole Activated state) among protected assets that are assigned public IP addresses (such as cloud server ECS instances, Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances, and Elastic IP Address (EIP) instances)
ExceptionIpCount.description_zh: 受保护公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例等）中，状态异常的IP（例如，处于黑洞中等）的数量

ExpireTimeCount.description_en: The number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that are about to expire (with a remaining validity period of less than 7 days)
ExpireTimeCount.description_zh: 即将到期（剩余有效期不足7天）的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
